TradeWorX is seeking licensed Journeyman Electricians for projects in North Dakota.

Pay & Benefits:
  • Pay Rate: $55/hour
  • Hotel Provided

  • Schedule: 6x10s, 60-70 hours/week

    • Top Benefits:

    • PTO
    • Company Paid Group Life Insurance
    • Accident and Critical Illness Policies
    • Critical Care

  • Valid Journeyman Electrician license from a reciprocal state accepted by North Dakota (MN, SD, IA, NE, MT, CO, UT, WY, NH, ME, ID, AR, AK)

  • Install and connect lighting, fire/life safety, and security wiring.
  • Perform testing, commissioning, and documentation of electrical systems.
  • Follow OSHA, NEC, and site safety protocols.

  • Work safely under OSHA and TradeWorX standards and collaborate with TradeWorX crews and site leadership
